fact: Biometric Update, citing the National Directorate of Civil Identification (DNIC), reports 856,101 national ID cards issued between January and June 2026, with biometric data collected for issuance.

The Council of Ministers updated the Regulations on Civil Identification and the National Identity Card, to secure issuance of National Identity Cards and standardise the process nationwide, with Civil Identification officials issuing across the country.

ATDI is developing a national digital ID project as part of the digital government architecture, and the EDGE mobile digital ID procurement has a shortlist submitted to the World Bank with contracting planned for September 2026.
The government extended free issuance of the national identity card (BI), with the birth certificate and personal registration booklet, to 2027 for children and adults, as announced by the President.
DNIC produced 856,101 National Identity Cards (BI) in the first half of 2026, with free first-time issuance nationwide since 13 November 2023, per its spokesperson.
